answer_1.quote: Chart summarization requires faithfully extracting quantitative data and describing them using natural language ... We present CHATS-CRITIC ... and CHATS-PI ... to generate high quality summaries.

answer_2.quote: We compare CHATS-CRITIC to reference‑based metrics, including BLEU, PARENT that takes the table into account, as well as BLEURT‑20 ...

answer_3.quote: We use PaLM‑2 (L) with Chain‑of‑thought for the entailment model ... The critic model drops some sentences. Please focus on the fluency of the paragraph ...
methods: chain‑of‑thought prompting for sentence‑level entailment classification

answer_4.quote: We randomly sampled 60 different charts ... surveyed the Entailment, Relevance, and Grammaticality (see Appendix B.1) ... The raters are 10 volunteering researchers ...
answer_4.guideline: For each sentence raters decide if it is (1) entailed, (2) relevant, and (3) grammatically correct.
